response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.average_wbc, pa.average_ratio AS ratio, pa.average_ratio - om.mean_ratio AS gap FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE pa.average_ratio > om.mean_ratio ORDER BY CASE WHEN pa.average_ratio - om.mean_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, gap DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero HCT gives an undefined ratio and is excluded from the ratio average.
